correctness.rationale: For fixed endpoints a,b on a finite tree, deleting any edge gives a cut. A covering walk must traverse an off-path edge at least twice and each a-to-b path edge at least once; performing subtree tours along that path attains 2e-d(a,b). In the Munn model (P,g), the range and domain idempotents are (P,1) and (g^(-1)P,1), so R fixes the initial-rooted tree, L the terminal-rooted tree, and H both endpoints. D allows translations: if Q=kP and h belongs to Q, the representative (P,k^(-1)h) links (P,g) by R to (Q,h) by L. Conversely such a link forces the translated-tree condition. For a covering walk starting at a nonidentity vertex a, the resulting Munn tree placed at identity is a^(-1)P and its terminal vertex is a^(-1)b; translation preserves distances. Thus maximizing d(a,b) gives the four displayed minima with the fixed endpoints, the initial or terminal eccentricity, or the diameter. For fixed rank, the verified graph-group shortlex theorem applies to the free group (no commutations); the reduced length of w[i+1..j] equals the Cayley-tree distance between the corresponding prefixes. Because the connected Munn subtree lies in a tree, this is also its internal distance. Simulating the logspace transducer on a virtual substring, counting output letters as emitted, and reusing its workspace makes each equality or distance query logarithmic space. Nested scans of prefix indices count first occurrences for e and maximize distances for the eccentricities and diameter, using only logarithmic counters. The final length comparisons, including the empty input, follow. The finite checker was inspected, not rerun; the logspace bound is analytic.
residual_risks: The tree-root translation in the covering-walk argument must be understood as above. No variable-rank or nonstandard-generator bound is inferred. The recorded 5461 rank-two word checks test the minima on bounded input and do not establish the resource bound.

value.rationale: The improvement from explicit deterministic linear space to logarithmic workspace for these natural languages is substantive. The method outputs exact class minima without storing the Munn tree, not just testing acceptance, and applies even to the classes with neither context-free nor co-context-free geodesic languages. Its value is the stronger resource bound and uniform method over the four classes at each fixed rank, not rederiving the known geometry.
residual_risks: No new logspace lower bound, indexed-language classification, or optimized running-time bound was established.
